# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About עולם הסקושים של תהל ואדל
An online store specializing in selling squishies — soft, squeezable collectible toys popular among kids, teens, and collectors. The store focuses on e-commerce with a product catalog and shopping experience centered around fun, colorful, and tactile toy merchandise.

- אספנים צעירים
- הורים לאספנים
- קונים מתנות
